topics.name: Dynamic Typing & GIL
topics.content: Python uses dynamic typing determined at runtime. The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) synchronizes thread execution.

topics.name: Dunder Methods & Polymorphism
topics.content: Special methods like __init__ and __repr__ enable custom operator overloading and polymorphism.

topics.name: RESTful Principles & Error Handling
topics.content: REST APIs use standard HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and status codes (200, 400, 500) with stateless request handling.

topics.name: Indexes & N+1 Query Problem
topics.content: Database indexes improve search speed. The N+1 query problem occurs when lazy loading causes excessive SQL queries.
